subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat support hiding the New messages action, and what recovery affordance must remain when unseen content accumulates?
rationale: The action currently protects discoverability when automatic following is disabled or suspended, so hiding it requires an intentional UX and accessibility contract rather than a mechanical preference addition.

options.title: Add a local presentation mode
options.body: Persist a browser-local Visible, Compact or dismissible, and Hidden mode while ensuring Hidden still provides an accessible catch-up path.

options.title: Keep the current action
options.body: Retain the always-visible catch-up action because its discoverability outweighs the reported obstruction.

options.title: Add gateway-managed policy
options.body: Expose a strict gateway WebChat setting only if maintainers want administrators to control this behavior across browser sessions and users.

recommendation.title: Add a local presentation mode
recommendation.body: Persist a browser-local Visible, Compact or dismissible, and Hidden mode while ensuring Hidden still provides an accessible catch-up path.
